name: State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF
blurb: The State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLE) is an exchange-traded fund that tracks the S&P Energy Select Sector Index, a market-cap-weighted index of US energy companies in the S&P 500. It holds 25 stocks, with top holdings including Exxon Mobil, Chevron, and ConocoPhillips. With over $41 billion in assets and a low expense ratio of 0.08%, XLE is one of the most widely used ETFs for gaining exposure to the US energy sector.
recent: Over the past month, XLE fell sharply, dropping 4.12% on May 6, 2026 to close at $57.00, amid rising oil prices and investor concerns over escalating Iran conflict. The ETF's 52-week range is $39.97 to $63.46, with the high reached in late March 2026. Recent news highlighted bullish sentiment on Berkshire Hathaway's energy holdings ahead of earnings and broader market declines driven by geopolitical tensions.
